title: Wall-E
synopsis: An empty Earth, a small trash compactor robot in love with a videotape, and a sleek probe who arrives looking for a plant.

nodes.text: Cubes of trash stacked like a city. Cockroach will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Add another floor” than after “Take a break.” In Sunrise Compaction, the rules change the moment you decide they can be tested.

choices.consequence: You choose to add another floor. By Cockroach, the decision has become data, precedent, and a problem larger than the person who made it.
You commit to take a break. It carries you toward Cockroach, exchanging a familiar uncertainty for a consequence nobody has modeled.

nodes.text: Humans and robots learn dirt together and a generation later the Axiom returns to a green Earth and a small old trash compactor at a treeline. The road into A First Forest began with “Stand together” in First Tree; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

Eve replays the hand-hold scene and Wall-E remembers everything, and the two of them dance in the dust without a single witness. The road into The Last Song began with “Wave to the cockroach” in First Tree; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

The captain grows a small box of tomatoes in his bridge and refuses to leave the ship until they ripen, which makes them all very late. The road into Captain's Garden began with “Take the third path” in First Tree; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
